'''Taran_Wanderer New Massassi Base OPs''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Taran_Wanderer]]
* '''Published:''' 26 October 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Massassi Base Operations / Echo Base Operations|TA-L-massassibaseoperations.gif|label=Massassi Base Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Massassi Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Massassi Base Operations Taran_Wan.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Slightly improved blowupthedeathstarwiththeobjective deck.

Please Critique my deck.

== Strategy ==

Basically flip the objective then blow up the Death Star.  Use Heading for the Medical Figate to get out Squadron Assignments, Do, or Do Not & Wise Advice (Anti-Jedi Power Effect), and Sai'torr Kal Fas.  Everything else is rather obvious as to its use (in my opinion).
